Hello!!
I am not able to install the package either by CRAN or GITHUB. The following error message appears for GITHUB: Error: Failed to install 'tRophicPosition' from GitHub:
System command 'Rcmd.exe' failed, exit status: 1, stdout & stderr were printed
And for CRAN:Warning in install.packages :
package 'tRophicPosition' is not available for this version of R.

My R version is 4.1.3.

Can you help me?? Installation attempts followed the instructions at this link: http://cran.nexr.com/web/packages/tRophicPosition/vignettes/Multiple_species_calculation_of_trophic_position_in_R.html
